notes.title: Fitter, Happier, More Productive, Comfortable
notes.content: [h3]Taxi Simulator – Devlog: AI and Environment Systems[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/a009ebf6591153ef59b69fa995b0e2168f039dce.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In recent weeks, we’ve mainly focused on developing our AI systems, improving NPC interactions, and further optimization.[/p][p][/p][p]The pedestrian system is now fully integrated with collision detection. Hitting a pedestrian results in a fine, and the pedestrian always gets back up—unless the player stops the car directly on them, in which case they get up only after the vehicle drives away. We’ve taken care of proper animations and environment reactions—after an incident, nearby NPCs respond appropriately and avoid the area for a while.[/p][p][/p][p]NPC AI is already working across most of the city. Pedestrians and vehicles can avoid each other and interact with simple objects (like phone booths). The system has been tested with 1,000 active NPCs near the player, consistently delivering around 50 FPS.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/5bcdd2d66f6af943e102b3bd95ec63a7b537d1e9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve added support for destructible objects—vehicles can ram into and deform them. Placing these objects on the map only requires specifying how they should react to collisions.[/p][p][/p][p]The weather system is now dynamic, and atmospheric conditions affect the environment (for example, puddles during rain or water drops on car bodies). Plant movement in response to wind is either in the works or partially implemented.[/p][p][/p][p]Traffic systems are still being developed—so far, we’ve mostly improved vehicle-player collisions. Work in this area is ongoing.[/p][p][/p][p]Apart from that, we’ve improved various mechanics and carried out more optimization. One known issue involves physics: in rare cases, a car can flip over if an NPC lands on the hood. This is related to changes introduced in Unreal Engine 5.5.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/e6a8e7ac814cfc3c745ec690ec03a6e0b56d2bb8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We tested various approaches to procedural map generation (PCG)—the current system is stable, pending final approval. We also reworked the lake environment (ultimately moving away from Nanite assets).[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve introduced a new standard for road width and lane count, along with tools for faster road editing. Our detail generation tools (like custom walls) have been improved, buildings have been updated (packed level actor), and new elements have been added to the demo area.[/p][p][/p][p]The phone UI has been updated: new graphics, backgrounds, and refreshed designs for the mechanic and taxi apps. An initial version of the HUD with minimap and notifications is also in place.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s it for the major updates. More soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Regarding our YouTube devlogs, the upcoming ones will most likely be in Polish with subtitles. Posting videos in alternating languages creates some confusion for new viewers.[/p]

notes.title: Whole Lotta Yellow
notes.content:
Yello.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/ec0b85b892433027c15e8e954bf5bd4015fcb350.png[/img]

We had an unusually hands-on March, which mostly went into improving the existing content, but a few new things were added, too.

The biggest ones are:

1. Traffic System. Standard feature for this kind of game; no need to elaborate. There are roads, AI cars drive on them. A classic, standard feature, but we've implemented it, so we're letting you know.

2. Game Structure. The loop roughly looks like this:

cutscene (a few dozen seconds) - mission (a few minutes) - grind (a few minutes) - cutscene (a few dozen seconds)

Of course, the time spent on missions or grinding will depend on your skills and preferences. I recommend imagining the flow of Taxi Simulator as something similar to what’s known from Underground 2. So, we have an open world with missions to trigger (which can be repeated in case of failure), and in between missions, we can do taxi orders to earn money, upgrade the car, and approach missions with a better handicap.

Right now, we're focusing on skills and phone handling. We’ll probably finish these features in April.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/ed45c6e0a0bc1ae63a79bf7606703daa43fc9f68.png[/img]

Here’s what the March patch looked like; maybe someone will be interested:

[list]
[*] We improved the loading and saving situation when the player has an accepted client or is in the vehicle.
[*] Fixed the issue where Nitro wouldn't auto-reload when its level reached 0.
[*] Fixed the bug with the tuning icon visible on the player.
[*] Fixed the triggers in buildings.
[*] Improved the hiding of indicators when entering the pause menu or journal.
[*] Improved waypoints on the map.
[*] Fixed the issue with the incorrect input behavior when entering tuning.
[*] After loading the game, Nitro doesn't reload and can't be used.
[*] Fixed the problem with icons – they disappeared and reappeared unexpectedly.
[*] Added visibility for the zone icon.
[*] The visual effect of the zone has been restored.
[*] Fixed the issue with tuning not loading from save in the build version.
[*] Improved the map size.
[*] Fixed the bug where sometimes clients were missing.
[*] Removed the crash-causing problem in Quest Graph Taxi.
[*] Updated the map.
[*] Improved the navigation system (handling intersections at different heights).
[*] Added the ability to navigate to objects.
[*] Introduced dynamic navigation – if the zone is unlocked, you can navigate to it, otherwise, the option is not available.
[*] Added automatic generation of navigation on roads/intersections and exclusions for sidewalks, etc.
[*] The selected icon stops at the corner of the minimap, indicating the navigation target.
[*] Added the ability to navigate to the client without prior acceptance.
[*] Fixed the reset function behavior.
[*] We removed the issue with the vehicle bouncing at the car wash.
[*] The journal window can now be closed with the same key it was opened.
[*] Improved vehicle behavior at high speeds.
[*] Changed vehicle parameters.
[*] Increased fuel and oil consumption depending on engine RPM.
[*] Added the traffic system (Traffic System currently available on the test map).
[*] Added new barriers and improvements to the map.
[*] Fixed the issue with empty references.
[*] Fixed the issue with target icons disappearing after entering and exiting the journal.
[/list]

notes.title: December 2024
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35280558/9760652e58f128f59776eef46c2b84e66f99236b.jpg[/img]

As the year draws to a close, here’s a quick rundown. Before you tune out, let me present the agenda—maybe one of the topics will catch your interest, and you can jump straight to it:

1. **Priest Simulator**  
2. **Mercyful Flames**  
3. **Taxi Simulator**  
4. **Your Principal**  

[h1]Priest Simulator[/h1]

Our most recognized franchise so far is keeping us busy:

The **Vampire Show** has left Early Access. However, we’ve already received feedback about some messed-up lipsync and issues with the final raid not registering correctly. We’ve fixed the first problem, and we’re working on the second. A patch is on its way.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2947900/Priest_Simulator_Her_Ghost_DLC/

We’ve released *Her Ghost*, a DLC for *Vampire Show*, offering about an hour of new gameplay. Some of you may remember that we declared the game finished months ago, but for various reasons, the launch was delayed. Sure, any game can be endlessly improved, so we added a few more cards to the Trello board. Plus, we wanted to experiment with creating DLC, so we decided to add new content roughly on the scale of *Heavy Duty*. Big thanks to everyone who purchased it.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35280558/a600c086e2e6a9d8b55b48b80c2334850957a4b6.jpg[/img]

We also made the soundtrack available some time ago. You can listen to it on Spotify or YouTube. The music video for the standout track *Legion* is doing pretty well at festivals:

- Winner: Best Polish Animated Music Video at PL Music Video Awards 2024  
- Winner: *Black Horse of Music Videos* at Ars Independent 2024  
- Semi-finalist: Azyl Shorts 2024  

It was also officially selected for:  
Animakom Fest 2024,  
Żubroffka 2024 (Music Video category),  
Animest 2024,  
Splat!FilmFest 2024,  
Grand Video Awards 2024 (Music Video category),  
Offeliada 2024,  
Linoleum 2024.  

Watch it here:  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oMop-7BM4ds  

That’s not all the news from the *Priest* universe. We’ve been working for months on the next installment, *Wolf Moon*. It continues threads from the previous games but takes them in a very different direction. It’s a low-poly action RPG inspired by MOBAs and *Vampire Survivors*. We intended to release the Steam page this year, but it’s not yet up to our standards.

[h1]Mercyful Flames[/h1]

We’ve really gone all out on this one. Last year, we made the tough decision to rework the game completely—a decision that was challenging but ultimately necessary. The original concept of a card-based RPG might resurface in a future project, but not here. *Mercyful Flames* always had great atmosphere but struggled with the transition of our physical designs into a digital format. 

This time, we went all in, inspired by a friend’s comment: “I’d buy a *Priest* game that’s just cutscenes.” While it’s an oversimplification, it nudged us toward creating a minimalist, gameplay-light experience.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35280558/9f43649f9c317bbbe19503dc7c6f5949339f975b.jpg[/img]

The game is going through what feels like its hundredth iteration. I admit I’ve gone a bit obsessive, tweaking every little detail. We keep adding minor dialogues or effects to enhance the illusion of a living world. The game is divided into dozens of “scenes,” and polishing one often makes others look subpar in comparison. At that point, we have to even things out, one way or another.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1066740/Mercyful_Flames_The_Witches/

As with *Vulgator*, we’ve collaborated with acclaimed Polish artists. This time, we worked with *Alembik*, a duo comprising Robert and Michał. You might know Michał from *Owls Woods Graves*, *Over the Voids*, and *Mgła* (live). They composed the soundtrack, which will also be available as a standalone album on streaming platforms.

[h1]Taxi Simulator[/h1]

Now for our biggest project. We’ve been dedicating our lives to this one and regularly post devlogs about its progress. The game has a completely different vibe from anything we’ve done before—less experimental, more craftsmanship. This time, the title isn’t some ironic twist; it’s exactly what it says.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159390/Taxi_Simulator/

**Your Principal** is temporarily on hold by mutual agreement with the publisher. We’ll return to it next year.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1176330/Your_Principal/

Apart from these titles, we’re also working on a port—or rather, a remaster—of a certain hit, but we’re not revealing any details yet.

By the way, you might have read rumors that we’re quitting game development to start selling weapons. Some reliable Polish media outlets got their facts and companies mixed up. I won’t bother denying it because it works in our favor.

notes.title: #21 We're still alive!
notes.content:
[h3]Skrrrrrrrt... [/h3]

Hey there, taxi enthusiasts and game lovers. We know you've been eagerly waiting for the latest scoop on Taxi Simulator, and we're here to serve up some juicy tidbits. So, fasten your seatbelts, because it's been a wild ride to get to where we are now!

🛑 SUSPENSION... but not in mid-air 🛑

Regrettably, the production of Taxi Simulator faced unforeseen challenges that resulted in an involuntary suspension for a duration of 1.5 years. These challenges encompassed a variety of complexities, which demanded careful consideration and strategic decision-making.

🛠️ Game Engine Switcheroo 🛠️

To address the production issues and ensure the delivery of a superior gaming experience, the development team made the critical decision to transition to Unreal Engine 5. This engine change required significant effort, but we firmly believe it will pave the way for the game's success and seamless performance.

💡 New Team, New Ideas 💡

With the engine switch came a brand-new team, brimming with fresh ideas and passion for Taxi Simulator. These folks revved up their creativity and worked tirelessly to bring you an exhilarating experience.

🎮 Vertical Slice - Just a Tasty Teaser 🎮

Yeah! Our team worked day and night to prepare a delectable vertical slice. It's like a delicious appetizer that gives you a taste of the whole meal. This slice reflects the true essence of Taxi Simulator and teases the thrill of what's to come.
We have a few fresh screenshots for you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/8b59ebe7231df8d750fc9edfb5f2c84e3e93d803.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/c7248f917fbb3989e4a60b7bf43d40412fe91c94.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/c18ffff57c4d4984d804d652b9e8f3d217043d45.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/ed056bfef41f28d79999d6e14e6a93399b6fe5bf.png[/img]

🗺️ Full Development Roadmap - Ready to Roll 🗺️

We're super excited to reveal that we've mapped out our entire development journey. We've got awesome features, jaw-dropping activities, and some surprises hidden up our sleeves. 

🌟 New Identity, New Image 🌟

In addition to refining the gameplay, we have devoted considerable effort to shaping Taxi Simulator's identity and image. We aim to create an engaging and distinctive brand that resonates with players and showcases the uniqueness of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/463bdeac9380660262e457c5f78051e5ec89d7f3.jpg[/img]
🙏 Gratitude and Thanks 🙏

We can't wrap this update without sending massive virtual hugs and heartfelt gratitude to all our amazing supporters! Your patience has driven our dedication to making Taxi Simulator the best it can be.

So, hang on tight and keep those eyes peeled for more exciting updates as we buckle down and seek a publisher for Taxi Simulator. Together, we'll create a game with you hailing taxis left and right.

Keep following us for more fun-filled news and surprises. See you soon!

Love and taxis,

The Taxi Simulator Dev Team 🚕💨
Till the next dev update!

notes.title: #20 Let's take a look at the progress!
notes.content:
[h3]Skrrrrrrrt... [/h3]

How are you doing drivers?!
It's been a while since we were here and we know you're eager to hear some [b]NEWS[/b] from us. 
🚕🚖🚕
Those past months have been very productive if it comes to developing the city. Manhattan lays on a quite large piece of land and is filled with many different districts. Placing buildings and props in the highest detail is a tedious work but it's also something that's definitely worth the wait! Thanks to it, we hope you'll be able to feel the real atmosphere - which is our main goal!

We are sharing a few screenshots of our amazing city and the famous yellow Taxi below 🚖 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/f39d60f07294ddf5ae6ed575ad50eeaff33bb264.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/f1fd6808f2ff73f46b254df3374f6f6d902e8ca8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/4ab258be2afc9e83c509f7052a90ee777ced3f3b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/95bacc4e1b8244cda154b5e00638db28a18aee1d.png[/img]

As we mentioned our goal is to make Taxi as realistic and immersive as possible, and that is why our city will also contain some of the most iconic places of NYC. In the background you can see one of the skyscrapers - [u]Chrysler Building[/u] which was originally built in 1930 and [u]is still the tallest brick building ever built in the world![/u] It consists of 77 floors with a lobby that's 'just' 3 stories high. There are a total of 3,862 windows that gaze out on New York. 

By the way, isn't that a beautiful view?! ⬇️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/3dbe5fb569dc8fc64971180c4b8bb1ac7bcf2d14.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/821e9e12a9e2afd13ae493dcedccf2d738eedb2f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/7584343d50ea9c24f86d71406faeceb58f0b7a7b.png[/img]

We know how much you can't wait to see the final product and that you're ready to sit behind the wheel of the yellow Taxi and start driving passengers around, but a project like this needs a lot of time and care from us. 
We want to make sure we deliver the best quality to all of you, our dear drivers! We pay attention to the smallest detail and even though it may seem like forever, we promise it'll be worth the wait! 
We're very happy to see that you made it all the way here with us. We would like to thank you for your continuous support and patience. 

Till the next dev update!

notes.title: Devlog #19
notes.content:
[h3][b]Skrrrrrrt![/b][/h3]

We advise you to pull over and stop your engine before you look at this, our dear Taxi driver!

We know you're busy in The Big Apple, but so are we.
Well.. why don't we take you on a quick trip through the city. Get in and buckle up if you're ready!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/9b994f55004d766b32619ae9a01b106fa43ea31a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/a280e7cd6d4e712a15fef229c9363675c9c23890.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/b95b118cc161cec46917a19bb6edc11b1cbb7ceb.jpg[/img]

While we're driving through the beautiful Manhattan and we're looking at the amazing scenery, it's time to tell you more about what we're working on. 

[h3][b]What's new?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] City improvements. We're constantly working on our scenery and we have added various decorations and props to make it as realistic as possible. We want you to get the real feel of New York City. Be ready to visit Times Square and look around for funny 'real life' inspired billboards. 

[*] New mechanics that will spice things up even more!
Did you know you'll be able to wash your taxi before you get off work after driving hundreds of miles with demanding passengers?
Our team is working on a car wash that will allow you to keep your cab nice and clean for your clients. The cleaner the taxi the happier the client so keep an eye on your cleanliness.

[*] Police system improvements. Several changes including speed, handling and turning are being revamped. The Police will now be able to watch over the city carefully to make sure you don't speed much or run the pedestrians over too often. Be careful, because if you try to run away, you'll end up being chased. Trust us, they'll push you off the road if they have to.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/26b00aa25c88dc9fcbd91a90f1fde6255674ff66.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/420bae7d87e43d7100e843848f52bd5419834f52.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/cd1474243e493032fa4df607efaaae0514d1d4ac.jpg[/img]

Well.. That's the end of our tour. How do you like our city?

One more thing. We would like to address one of the most frequently asked question - [u]Will Taxi Simulator support steering wheels?[/u]

Skrrrt! Yes, you better get them ready folks! Put your hat on, turn on the radio and let's roll!

Join our Discord ⬇️

[url=https://discord.gg/Wfg9AKM52D][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/755ee5f56fc0c022ae6adb9a517d68cd0b071b21.png[/img][/url]

Happy trails!
Woodland Games

notes.title: Devlog #18
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Taxi Drivers![/h2]


We don't know how you are, but our summer is soooo hot! We are starting to envy the people of New York that they can legally go topless 😎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/e31cadbe5027d49d055092501df8c9f85e2bb614.png[/img]

[h3]But we're here to tell you a little more about the game's progress. So let's make a small summary:[/h3]

[list]
[*] The city is ready (yuuuppi!) - we already have all the models of houses and streets, but due to the care with which it was made, we are currently working on... reducing the details or better call it optimaliation. The point is, it's just so polished that probably only NASA computers would be able to run Taxi Simulator :D Don't worry, we won't flatten the city - it will still be very clear, you will still have the opportunity to see many details!

[*] Decorations - we bring models of trees, garbage, benches and fire hydrants to the city. It take time, because after each game we have to test - if the board is too heavy, cause of bugs, etc.

[*] Scenarios - our brave Narrative Designer, Darek, constantly adds new scenarios, so there will be quite a lot of them 😉 You will not be bored :D But we will tell you about the scenarios themselves in a separate devlog, because there is something to write about (especially about research and real stories of taxi drivers).
[/list]

We also re-design TAXI, see for yourself:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/99c0efc3f56796d54a4886564a06f2a02ce08de0.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #17
notes.content:
[h2]Hello taxi drivers![/h2]

Welcome to the new devlog! What do we have to say today?
As always, a lot! 🚕🚕🚕

[h3]Let's start with... a mechanic 😉[/h3]

You often ask us about the possibility of personalizing your taxis. Will it be possible? 

We answer: [b]YES! [/b]

What's more, our team of graphic designers is currently working on elements that you will be able to add, change and improve. These include: rims, bumpers, rims and skirts. But, but... personalization will also apply to the interior! Do you want luxurious leather? Why not! 😉

We are talking about such goodies 😉:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/fa56b490f80ee432ae9a66bc075a59379962a2aa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/55588b6c6a88caa62e12f45ba6ea80db26b89079.png[/img]

On top of that, we have a new ad pack, which means that city building is slowly coming to an end! We implement decorations, and then we will take care of optimization, because each of these things weighs a lot, and you complain that your computers are like old vacuum cleaners - we do not promise that Taxi Simulator will work freely on all devices, but we hope that many of them will do 🚖


Today we will not spam you with beautiful Manhattan - we will leave it for the next devlog: for now, we wish you a good weekend and remember that we are always waiting for you on our discord ⬇

[url=https://discord.gg/6YMfQ6P][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/755ee5f56fc0c022ae6adb9a517d68cd0b071b21.png[/img][/url]

Woodland Games Team

notes.title: DevLog #16
notes.content:
[h2]Hello taxi drivers![/h2]
Today we want to say HI with this that song:

[previewyoutube=mbj1RFaoyLk;full][/previewyoutube]

We know, The Doors come from California, not New York, but today, as you guessed, the devlog will be about... light! 💡💡💡💡
We have already presented Manhattan several times, which looked like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/d1b54444ea241f42b81a15f2e399344eda56ab59.png[/img]

And like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/705c4e2ff6cecf95f6aa2401e44798279101f05a.png[/img]

These are still the same streets, but their magic is determined by the lighting. It makes the game look more realistic, we enjoy not only completing missions, but also driving aimlessly...

Although it's a detail, it is - in our opinion - especially important in open-world games. The very performance of the mission is one thing, but we want players to come back to the game also when they just want to ride and relax 😉

[h2]What does lighting work mean?[/h2]

[b]- Color temperature [/b]- we set it to make the light effect spatial. It is thanks to this that the sun between the leaves seems real
[b]- Light propagation [/b]- how far is it to go, where and what it will affect, and where and how strongly it is reflected from individual buildings.

We are also working on the post process - these are various effects, including color tweaking, but also vignettes, photo effects. It's also about working on presets for different times of the day and different weather conditions, so that a foggy morning or a rainy evening is as real as possible.

Here is a small video from our invaluable partner Beffio how Manhattan looks by day and by night:

[previewyoutube=gVPtADw4sss;full][/previewyoutube]

We are also working on plants, but we will tell you about this and a few mechanics next time 😉 Why? Oh, cause we will have a lot of nice renders and screens! 🌳🌳🌳🌳

[h2]Don't forget join to our #Discord ⬇⬇⬇⬇[/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/AdKFcTJgsv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/755ee5f56fc0c022ae6adb9a517d68cd0b071b21.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159390/Taxi_Simulator/ 

Read you soon, 
Woodland Games Team

notes.title: Devlog #15
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello Taxi Drivers![/b][/h3]
We promised to come back with a new update in a while, so: [b]HERE WE ARE![/b] 🚖🚖🚖

Last time you said you lack a bit of a mess in our New York City. That these streets are so little New York - no advertisements on the buildings, which makes it too... clean. Don't worry, we are finishing work on the buildings for now. Fact - they require the greatest commitment.

Of course, the ads are also important and are being developed in the meantime. Today, a few examples that will soon hang on the streets of New York in Taxi Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/92efc7f0ebe824ab54e00b598bff0f1242550073.png[/img]

As you can see, there is a lot of it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/ec0ba01a05ba31910e38b0d4885aa988e5ec0dd8.png[/img]

We also promised you some information about the [b][h3]gameplay [/h3][/b]itself... We feel stupid to write about something we are still working on, but we understand that you would like to know what to expect 😉

If you thought that you would be driving in Manhattan with impunity like madmen 🏎, then… NO 🛑 
We are working on a police mechanic that will chase/search/or nothing if you are driving in the law.
What is it going to be about? In our assumption, the police start to be interested in us with every offense we have committed - of course, running over a traffic cone is not terrible, but if you pass a man... that's another story 😉 Police cars will patrol the place of the last offense, and if they notice the crazy taxi drivers (we mean YOU) - they will go to chase 🚔🚔🚔 How it will end - it's a surprise 😉


We also assure you that just having a taxi does not mean that you can go crazy with it! Crown Victoria will break down. Just like that, randomly if we don't care for them properly. At the moment we have dealt with the engine, but then we will think about an empty tank ⛽️ What solution do you think is better:
[h3]- we reduce the maximum speed to 5 km/h?
- ordering a tow truck - remember that its cost is much higher than that of fuel?
- we call buddy Joe, who pushes the car to the nearest station?[/h3]
Or maybe you have any other idea? 😉

Finally, a nice #screenshot of Manhattan!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/2fc65a842c40f0d29548c2d288191cb20e47c659.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/fd7eecd623cc8c44e4b9f0f5306de00fabbb071f.png[/img]

Remember that if you want to read about something specific on the next devlog - let us know in the comments, we promise that we will try to make it :>

[h3]Join our #Discord[/h3] ⬇⬇⬇⬇⬇⬇
[url=https://discord.gg/j3yRTVvy4a][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/755ee5f56fc0c022ae6adb9a517d68cd0b071b21.png[/img][/url]

Read you soon, 
Woodland Games Team

notes.title: Devlog #14
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello Taxi drivers 😊[/b][/h3]

We come to you with a small (okay, not so small!) Update about Taxi Simulator. Today we will show you more screens from Manhattan and tell you a bit about what's next with the project...

Let’s begin!

[h2][b]1. Graphics[/b][/h2]
As you can see Manhattan is growing. We have added more streets that are slowly filling up with traffic. It will sound immodest, but every time we look at these graphics, we cannot stop admiring the details :P

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/19f854adb2abafd85f729f946a242ad610469bdc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/399de505bfb63a9a37ee72362fdf99cc95e41183.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/754810f04f32f22cd87e54062da590de2f67eb99.png[/img]

[h2][b]2. BULL[/b][/h2]
Many people associate BULL more with Chicago than with New York - oh those sports teams :P Meanwhile, this charging bull has been standing bravely for several decades before the New York Stock Exchange. Not only is it huge, it has also become the mascot of professional stockbrokers. Legend has it that anyone who touches his genitals will be rich - so if you're in New York - don't be embarrassed 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/df5bacad974e5e164b9c8322104f49568582045b.png[/img]

[h2][b]3. Gameplay[/b][/h2]
We have already added most of the mechanics to the game. And we started internal tests 😉 As it turned out, it is quite good, but not flawless :D Interesting facts - we show you how we work on the visual aspect of the city, the main streets are simply beautiful, meanwhile... we forgot about the alleys and side roads. Anyway, see on the screenshots below how it looked at the very beginning, and now after some minor changes :P We also left a few plots for decorations - fountains, benches. Don't worry, we'll fill the empty spaces for sure :P

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/ddb3bfa1dbcaa20519e3309754304cdbf6868432.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/efc2b26da789ef620a38a66694c3b7c9fd017e93.png[/img]


[h2][b]4. What's next?[/b][/h2]
We have started work on additional mechanics, which also include interactions with other NPC. What happens when we collide with another car? Or what if we're not very nice to the passenger? We will tell you about it next time 😉

We hope that we have satisfied your curiosity at least for a while 😊 We are still working on Taxi Simulator, so do not be afraid that we will abandon the project - we want to give you a game that will bring a lot of satisfaction to everyone 😊

Remember that we are still waiting for you on our discord ⬇️⬇️⬇️
[url=https://discord.gg/8yjyBMs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/755ee5f56fc0c022ae6adb9a517d68cd0b071b21.png[/img][/url]

Read you soon!
Taxi Drivers from Woodland Games Team

notes.title: Lucky #13
notes.content:
[b]Unlucky #13[/b]
Apparently, the number #13 is unlucky - we hope to disenchant it, because you have #Devlog number #13 ahead of you! And today a looooot of nice graphics 😉

We can safely say that most of Manhattan has already been prepared. The city map is huge, we tried to put as much detail as possible on it. We took care of every detail to reflect the spirit of New York. Anyway, see for yourself:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/0ae6f13f343563999790718976de38044c6d7cb3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/f80691e64d75f630c1a54d39d9508b23b2da9049.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/adb8ec8bce2ab038ade00cae1d5ad0b8662d3528.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/81f73eeb8a01be1e329b689f6495b4ce381409c8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/63651324aeeccc2e839ca334925c7b198b0510c2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/dc7bb4ac95f53fe719f88446b58e2a3b530b1c2a.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/30e29e1ca8f6d9391fa5a99746df24ba7b372427.png[/img]


At this stage of production, we add mechanics one by one. The first "fire" was human traffic. And as it turned out, we ran into some graphical problems here, as you can see below. The amount of details makes our city disappear into the charming Magenta 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845552/1043c5c7e132ef76f118e843686e806ca415fe5a.png[/img]

Don't worry, we still have some time to fix it! After adding people, we will also be adding car traffic, which is sure to be demanding as well. At the same time, we are working on the UI and UX, so if something seems illegible to you at the moment, it will probably become clear in the next devlog 😉

[b]What else is left for us to do?[/b]
- working on needs (car repair, refueling)
- selection tree (after accepting the client or rejecting it)
- consequences of elections (deduction, quitting job)
...and a few more "little things" about which we will inform you soon!

If you still didn’t add to wishlist – it’s good moment! 

And don’t forget join to discord ⬇️
